title: File Content and Management Tools
summary: This module provides a collection of tools for interacting with file systems and various file types, including reading, searching, and compressing. It also includes a specialized tool for fetching and downloading academic papers from Arxiv.

nodes.label: Base Tool Interface
nodes.title: Base Tool Interface
nodes.description: Provides the foundational structure and common methods for all tools within the CrewAI framework.

nodes.label: Base RAG Tool
nodes.title: Base RAG Tool
nodes.description: Extends the BaseTool to provide Retrieval-Augmented Generation capabilities, enabling semantic search over various data types.

nodes.label: Search CSV Content
nodes.title: CSV Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search queries against the content of CSV files, returning relevant information based on similarity.

nodes.label: List Directory Files
nodes.title: Directory Read Tool
nodes.description: Recursively lists all files within a specified directory, providing their paths for further processing.

nodes.label: Search Directory Content
nodes.title: Directory Search Tool
nodes.description: Performs semantic search across all text content found within files in a given directory.

nodes.label: Search DOCX Content
nodes.title: DOCX Search Tool
nodes.description: Allows semantic search queries to be executed against the textual content of DOCX (Microsoft Word) documents.

nodes.label: Compress Files/Directories
nodes.title: File Compressor Tool
nodes.description: Compresses a specified file or directory into an archive format (e.g., ZIP, TAR), useful for archiving data.

nodes.label: Read File Content
nodes.title: File Read Tool
nodes.description: Reads the entire content of a specified file or a specific range of lines from it.

nodes.label: Search JSON Content
nodes.title: JSON Search Tool
nodes.description: Facilitates semantic search within JSON file content, extracting relevant data based on the query.

nodes.label: Search MDX Content
nodes.title: MDX Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search queries against the content of MDX (Markdown with JSX) files.

nodes.label: Search PDF Content
nodes.title: PDF Search Tool
nodes.description: Performs semantic search on the textual content of PDF documents, retrieving information relevant to a query.

nodes.label: Search TXT Content
nodes.title: TXT Search Tool
nodes.description: Allows semantic search queries to be executed against the content of plain text (.txt) files.

nodes.label: Search XML Content
nodes.title: XML Search Tool
nodes.description: Enables semantic search queries against the content of XML files, extracting relevant data.

nodes.label: Fetch Arxiv Papers
nodes.title: Arxiv Paper Tool
nodes.description: Fetches metadata for academic papers from the Arxiv API and optionally downloads their PDF versions.

nodes.label: Arxiv API
nodes.title: Arxiv API
nodes.description: External API for accessing academic paper metadata and PDF links.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: Local File System
nodes.description: The local storage system where files and directories are managed, read, and written.

groups.label: File Content Search Tools
groups.title: RAG-based File Search
groups.description: A collection of tools designed for semantic search across various file formats using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

groups.label: File System Management
groups.title: Local File Operations
groups.description: Tools for fundamental interactions with the local file system, including reading file contents, listing directories, and compressing files.

groups.label: External Data Retrieval
groups.title: Arxiv Paper Access
groups.description: A specialized tool for fetching academic paper metadata and optionally downloading PDFs from the Arxiv platform.

groups.label: Tool Base Classes
groups.title: Foundational Tool Structures
groups.description: Abstract base classes that define the common interfaces and core functionalities for all tools in the system.
